title: AssertionException: Out of memory in the Entities Graphics chunk metadata buffer. Attempted to allocate 34 elements, buf
notes: Fix 2026-11-16 by claude (44319aa3d5): Prism show/hide toggled the DisableRendering tag; Entities Graphics strips/re-adds its chunk component per whole chunk, so every frame that showed anything minted a new rendered chunk no later entity joined, and long-lived prisms pinned ~1 entity per chunk until the 1M-element chunk-metadata buffer (~30.8k chunks of the 34-property prism archetype) ran out at 12k-35k entities - visibility is now MaterialMeshInfo's enable bit (non-structural) in PrismRenderService (prototype, SetVisible, FlushVisibility, the three debris spawners; RestampColors ignores enable bits) plus the Amoebius shim's MaterialMeshInfo made enableable; also seen on 4 players' editors per the analytics Errors page (167 occurrences, 2026-11-13 to 11-15)
